arStrings.szText: Killing an enemy empowers your next {c_important}Thrash{/c} to generate {c_number}{SF_13}{/c} additional Vigor. This stacks up to the next {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} Casts of {c_important}Thrash{/c}.
Each hit of {c_important}Thrash{/c} has a {c_number}[{SF_30}*100|%|]{/c} chance to reduce an active Cooldown by {c_number}[{SF_32|1|}]{/c} seconds.
Each hit of {c_important}Thrash{/c} increases the damage that enemy takes from {c_important}Thrash{/c} by {c_number}[{SF_31}*100|%x|]{/c}, stacking up to {c_number}[{SF_34}*100|%x|]{/c}.

{c_important}Thrash's{/c} {c_number}1st{/c} and {c_number}2nd{/c} attacks have a {c_number}[{SF_26}*100|%|]{/c} chance to also unleash its {c_number}3rd{/c} attack that is {c_number}[{SF_27}*100|%|]{/c} larger and deals {c_number}[{SF_28}*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage.

{c_important}Thrash's{/c} {c_number}3rd{/c} attack deals {c_number}[SF_33*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage. {c_important}Thrash{/c} continues to unleash its {c_number}3rd{/c} attack if Cast again within {c_number}[{SF_4}|1|]{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Thrash{/c} becomes an {c_important}Eagle{/c} Skill that deals Lightning damage. 

{c_important}Thrash's{/c} {c_number}3rd{/c} attack deals {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_THIRD_C}{/c} damage and creates a moving {c_important}{u}Spirit Storm{/u}{/c} that Sparks enemies for {c_number}{dot:LIGHTNING_DOT}{/c} damage.
